_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Nyɔnu {player_id} nye LinesOfAction ƒe nyɔnu.
Wo ƒe kluwo nye '{side}', kɔkɔtɔ ƒe kluwo nye '{other}'.
Fiazikpui ƒe ŋkɔ: `[b1b3]` (akpa gbɔ akpa me). Fiazikpui si wɔwɔ le mɔxenu, gbɔtɔ, alo ŋgɔdɔƒe akpa ƒe xexlẽ si nye kluwo ƒe xexlẽ (gbɔƒe klu) le eme. Ameaɖeƒe wo ƒe kluwo, gake me kɔkɔtɔ ƒe kluwo; ƒeƒe kɔkɔtɔ ƒe klu la, woaɖe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ele be format nanye e2e4 (tso coordinates,to).
invalid_move.identical: Afisi wòtso kple afisi yim wòle la sɔ.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Ele be woazɔ tẽe alo le dzogoewo dzi.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Ele be woazɔ mɔ didi aɖe si sɔ kple esiwo le ƒuƒoƒo ɖeka me.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Futɔ la ƒe akpa aɖe xe mɔa.
invalid_move.destination_own: Wo ŋutɔ ƒe asrafowo le teƒea.

game_action.captured_suffix: Nyɔnu {player_id} fiazikpui {from} -> {to} eye woaɖe kɔkɔtɔ ƒe klu.

outcome.draw_no_capture: Woɖe afɔ 60 gake womekpɔ kpɔ o.
